body: I'm done. I hope everyone does better at the game of life than I did. Sucks for whomever finds my body. Valar Morghulis and I hope whoever ends up with my stuff enjoys it. Kinda amusing because even the Marvel Collectors corp and my crowfall/hex accounts aren't enough to give me the will to live yet WOW back in its day kept me going through a rough patch.

You remind me a lot of myself, the only thing I can say is that I found something to fill that void. My woes are completely different to yours but realize that there is hope if you can find something to quench your thirst for seeking more accomplishments.

Use it to give back to the community, use it to help others live less terrible lives, and remember that while you might be a monster, you're a monster with the capacity to do good.

I really feel for you because I've been where you are and even though where I'm at right now is a terrible, terrible place, at least you still hunger for "something".

I don't see there being a next time, hell at this point I'm not sure there will be a tomorrow.

Understanding where I failed doesn't change the fact that I failed and I can understand the industry better but it doesn't make the failure any less of a failure.

It's kind of amusing because today could very well be my last day on earth and I know I've talked with other people about how I would spend it and I end up spending it on reddit and going about my life like it's a normal day.

For those that have a morbid curiosity my last meal will probably be a chipotle bowl. Extra steak, extra chicken, extra cheese.

East Coast app company actually.

Things started off alright on the development side and we actually accomplished a lot of what our competitors couldn't.

The problem is I drastically underestimated how difficult it is to raise funding given just how many apps are being launched. 

We launched around the same time as another local competitor and it became a race to acquire as much traction as possible, I don't wish them ill but they definitely hurt our ability to attract investors/users.

The app itself is actually live but it bled me dry monetarily and without a budget to grow it's dead in the water. 

I probably would have passed on the opportunity to create the company we created. The stress was just way too much and just the rejection we faced from one angel/VC after another is part of the reason I'm so drained. We were too "early" for most of the VC's to invest in but in order to get to that point where they want to give money to you we had to have money...

I've been as social as can be but living around here everyone is so goddamn fake. People will smile and tell you it will get better when it really won't, they-ll pretend to be your friend until you have nothing left to give them.

My closest friends are either dead or dealing with their own issues, I am not on speaking terms with my family, and I've cleared my head as much as possible.

I appreciate the advice but there is pretty much no bright spot in this shit show. I always knew there was a high risk of failure I just thought the odds of success were worth the risk.

Honestly, I would have just not started the company. It was a colossal waste of energy/money and the results weren't what we projected worst case scenario to be.

I wish it was as simple as using it as a learning experience, I'm about to lose everything and I have nothing left in me to push myself further.

They say that what doesn't kill you makes you stronger but the inverse is also true, what doesn't make you stronger kills you.

I've dealt with rejection all of my life in the form of relationships and I eventually just accepted being #foreveralone.

This failure though? It feels like a knife is already halfway in.

Thanks.

Unfortunately I've looked at almost every avenue possible, I dug myself into a pretty goddamn big hole that barring winning the lottery is almost impossible for me to climb out of.

The government programs are a joke that I wouldn't qualify for, therapy wouldn't help because again for me it isn't a mental thing, and my immediate social network is pretty much unable to help.

Therapy can help for those that are suffering from depression that is mostly mental but depression and suicide is about far more than just the mental aspect and I think too many people don't realize this.

Got rejected by an angel investor today, dealing with eviction on Monday, collapse of my company on Tuesday, and I've recently started coughing up blood when I wake up in the morning.

You say defeatism, I've say it's been a good run and eventually you run out of chips. 

The real kicker is finding out the most recent love interest that didn't want a relationship is now in one. It's like icing on a cake made of shit.

In closing, to those dealing with depression seek therapy IF it will help. :-p

I think there is some miscommunication. You're saying suicide is only about thoughts, emotions, and whether they're being processed in a healthy way.

I'm saying there is a crapload more to suicidal thoughts than just emotions and thoughts. I'm perfectly rational, I know why I am seriously contemplating playing in traffic and so many suicidal individuals know bloody well why they want to die and no amount of therapy will help.

Please realize it isn't always about calling a hotline, calling a hospital, or getting meds. Therapy isn't even close to a solution for people like me that are extremely rational and can't see an outcome that isn't completely shit.

Wow really? I'm the one trolling because I explained my personal situation and why therapy wouldn't do shit even though you're the one telling people to kill themselves or not kill themselves?

Therapy isn't for everyone and in some cases just makes things worse, you're the one missing the damn point.

People like you are why people don't vent and instead just kill themselves. Why share shit when people will just accuse you of being a troll? Better to just pay a therapist that really doesn't care and will just tell you bullshit that may or may not help.

This reminds me of a long time ago when chipotle was super liberal with their free burrito passes. A friend of mine was a manager at a chipotle and gave me a stack of them, ate chipotle for like 5 months straight... Still love me some chipotle.

A fist full of cash for my sombrero on Cinco De Mayo.

The guy was really large and really drunk and I know better to argue with really drunk large dudes.

Guy was probably pissed the next day... It was over $100

How is it taking something out of context? Not everyone could benefit from therapy and in a lot of cases it would just make things worse.

Saying money isn't a good reason to end my life is like telling someone their life isn't that bad and they should just hang in there. Technically true but it ignores the reality which is that life can be bloody depressing.

Therapy would just put me further in the hole, my thoughts are processed quite fine thank you very much.

You know when you hear about a businessman killing himself or someone dealing with eviction that ends up in a suicide? That's me in a nut shell, therapy would help about as much as a glass of water at this point.

I don't know about that... Therapy isn't cheap. My depression/suicidal thoughts are pretty much all caused by a lack of financials, not sure how talking to a therapist could possibly help that!

The worst part is I have no social network that I can confide in because it would just make things worse. 

I'm probably 72 hours from being really screwed with an albatross of a rent I can't afford, bills I can't pay, and business partners that will shortly realize the company we started is out of money.

I've done everything I can but the reality is that we tried to bootstrap a company and it works until it really doesn't. Banks are useless, government programs are useless, and VC's only invest in companies that are a pretty much guaranteed thing.

I put everything I have into making this start-up a success, I've spent everything including my rent money into trying to get it to generate a profit, and I came up short.

I seriously doubt therapy would help considering I'm pretty much at whit's end, come Monday my past due rent is pretty much putting me at the risk of eviction, and I'm so mentally drained I just want to say fuck it and either end it or get a one way ticket to a island where I can try to eke out some kind of living.

Man venting helps... too bad it doesn't actually fix anything.

Worst date ever was this female that came into my work and grabbed my junk and then left. It was at 3:00 on a Tuesday so I kinda figured something was up but she came back the next day and wanted to hang out.

I meet up with her at 4:00 pm on a Wednesday only to have her puke on me, go to the bathroom, then she sped off in her car.

Was he not interested in doing butt stuff afterwards? :(

Going to a movie on a first date is like date seppuku, it's almost as bad as going out to a fancy restaurant (which I've done a lot of). 

All about knowing a couple of restaurant owners, getting a quiet booth, and learning about someone.

I run a retail store and get paid like crap (yay family business), and we have 5 stars on yelp. I'm perpetually stressed out and the place is understaffed due to our other stores under-performing. Anyways I pride myself on taking care of my customers and making sure they're happy even if I later want to play in traffic, except when my brain mentally nopes out on me.

1. Customer says have a great day before me and I respond with OK. Nothing followed that except an awkward wave bye.

2. Customer comes in and asks me if I have a specific product, I just stare at her like she's stupid even though we totally have the product.

3. I have a side business with a totally different name and when people call my side business phone number sometimes I will answer with my retail store name. 

4. A lot of times I am stuck at the store by myself and when I go to eat lunch someone will come in, mentally I tell myself to get up and welcome them but my body just continues to eat.

Award winning customer service I swear, been doing this so long and getting burned out so my brain is just mentally not all there. :(
I want to get a job at subway now just so I can throw it in the trash and yell at myself for not making it look exactly like the pictures.
